objective: Let ProjectOS establish the truth about an interrupted run from the repository and its own records, so a crash leaves a question it can answer rather than a state nobody can trust: a resume must describe the run it claims to continue, a refused resume must not damage the record it failed to recover, and what the last run left behind must be reported rather than silently overwritten.
